description: This file defines a minimal implementation of a circuit breaker pattern in Dart, including the CircuitBreaker class and a custom exception for open circuits.

classes.name: CircuitBreaker
classes.description: Implements a circuit breaker that opens after a specified number of consecutive failures, preventing further calls for a cooldown period.

classes.name: CircuitOpenException
classes.description: An exception thrown when attempting to call a protected function while the circuit is open.

methods.name: protect
methods.description: Wraps a function call, executing it unless the circuit is open, and manages failure count and state.
